QuestInfo.name: Patience Incarnate
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2101002##k battles an incompetent king and a greedy queen to bring peace to #b#m260000000##k. Learn Willpower from her.
QuestInfo.1: It will take people of strong willpower to bring peace to #m260000000#. Eleska wants you to get some supplies for #m260000000#.\r\n\r\n#y3936# #b(#u3936#)#k

0.0: The Sand Bandits need someone with a stronger will. Maybe that's you, but I can't tell for sure yet. Try harder.
0.1: But it's not yet time...more preparations must be made. I'd like you to obtain some supplies for us. It shouldn't be a challenge for you.

no.0: A refusal? That only proves that you have no willpower!

1.0: You have so much willpower! What a relief! If we had a few more like you, we'd reclaim #m260000000# from that incompetent King and greedy Queen in no time! But for now, we just have to be patient.

quest.0: We need someone with more willpower!
